ABOUT THE MAJOR

The Environmental Science, B.S. is appropriate for students desiring broad scientific training for government, business and nonprofit organizations, or graduate study in fields related to the environment. The program benefits from Fresno Pacific University's proximity to California's national forests, parks, wildlife refuges and diverse agricultural systems. The program encourages internships with local organizations and student research. Students are also encouraged to supplement their major with summer coursework offered at one of several excellent off-campus programs. Courses taken through these programs may be used as electives or, when appropriate, substituted for required courses.


MAJOR ELECTIVE REQUIREMENT

Students in the Environmental Science, B.S. will select 12-16 units in consultation with the program faculty to meet the 54 units required in the major (minimum of 12 units from Natural Sciences). See catalog for list of courses and further details.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
